# AbstractAssistant

> A macOS-first tray assistant and CLI that is a thin client of AbstractGateway: the gateway owns workflows, durable runs, tools, workspace policy and multimodal defaults; the app owns the interface, local preferences and voice capture/playback. Use these docs to install it, connect it to a gateway, configure it, and understand what runs where.

Repository: https://github.com/lpalbou/abstractassistant

## Core Docs
- [README.md](README.md): overview, capabilities, quick start, local files
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): documentation index
- [docs/INSTALLATION.md](docs/INSTALLATION.md): pip install, the `voice` extra, the optional macOS app bundle
- [docs/getting-started.md](docs/getting-started.md): start a gateway, launch the palette, first turn, approvals, shortcuts
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): components, gateway boundary, sessions on the gateway, automations and the event stream (diagram, follower, attention model, capability gate), run lifecycle with live replies, console sign-in hand-over, module map
- [docs/api.md](docs/api.md): CLI entry points and flags (`--gateway-handover-file`, `run --stream`), which gateway the app connects to (incl. the `~/.abstractframework/gateway.json` pointer file), environment variables, run input pins, live reply events, gateway routes used (sessions, automations and the event stream included), local files
- [docs/faq.md](docs/faq.md): recurring questions and known limits
- [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md): symptoms, causes and fixes

## Topic Deep Dives
- [docs/settings.md](docs/settings.md): every setting (the Workflow page with Open in AbstractFlow and the account Time zone, Stream replies, MTP depth, the account and chat workspaces, tool categories sorted and collapsed, the global shortcut's Accessibility state and Configure, appearance, About), its source (gateway default vs. this app) and its storage in preferences.json
- [docs/voice.md](docs/voice.md): spoken replies, dictation, the hands-free conversation loop and its failure handling
- [docs/automations.md](docs/automations.md): configurable growing-context budgets and result email; scheduled tasks on the gateway as the Assistant shows them: the Sessions | Automations tabs, New automation and Schedule this conversation (Gateway default first; When = Repeat / Daily / Weekly / Monthly / Once at / email, the gateway's schedule-preview sentence and the account time-zone line; stop after / stop at), served schedule and next run, tool consent, runs as chat pairs, controls, answering waits by kind, Discuss, notifications from your event stream (the attention line, the menu-bar badge, one notification per item on a Mac), the capability gate, limits

- [phone/iphone/README.md](phone/iphone/README.md): AbstractAssistant for iPhone (0.16.0), the container of the watch app (one product, two independent devices: each signs in on its own, the sign-in a Keychain item shared with that device's notification extension; Apple push with notification service extensions, [phone/iphone/BUILD.md](phone/iphone/BUILD.md) lists the five targets and bundle ids), native iPhone assistant, scoped tools and automations, notifications and tab badges from your event stream, generated images and voice attached to restored messages; [phone/iphone/CHANGELOG.md](phone/iphone/CHANGELOG.md) records native release history; [phone/iphone/docs/architecture.md](phone/iphone/docs/architecture.md) covers authenticated artifact previews and session restoration; [phone/iphone/BUILD.md](phone/iphone/BUILD.md) covers isolated builds; [phone/iphone/docs/distribution.md](phone/iphone/docs/distribution.md) explains combined iPhone + independent Watch delivery in one Store listing, credential-free CI, human-approved uploads and TestFlight-to-Store promotion

- [phone/iphone/docs/troubleshooting.md](phone/iphone/docs/troubleshooting.md): dated automation runs, failure explanations, provider versus phone authentication, notifications and Apple push (the push forwarder, generic words on development builds), installed version/build and Apple-managed updates
- [docs/macos-signing.md](docs/macos-signing.md): signing and notarizing the macOS app bundle (`build-macos-app --sign`, `--notarize`, `--dmg`, `--local-test`)
- [web/README.md](web/README.md): the Assistant on the web, a scaffold run by hand against a gateway (not a release)

## Design Records
- [docs/adr/README.md](docs/adr/README.md): architecture decision records
- [docs/adr/0001_gateway_native_assistant_v2.md](docs/adr/0001_gateway_native_assistant_v2.md): the gateway-native boundary
- [docs/adr/0005_one_apple_project.md](docs/adr/0005_one_apple_project.md): one product and one project for iPhone and Apple Watch, the bundle ids, the push package; amended: no sign-in passes between the devices
- [docs/adr/0004_notes_inside_the_assistant_abstractnote_stays_a_service.md](docs/adr/0004_notes_inside_the_assistant_abstractnote_stays_a_service.md): notes inside the Apple apps, AbstractNote stays a gateway service
- [docs/backlog/overview.md](docs/backlog/overview.md): planned and proposed work
- [watch/apple/README.md](watch/apple/README.md): AbstractAssistant for Apple Watch (0.16.0, pre-release through TestFlight), the independent companion of the iPhone app (one product, one project `phone/iphone/project.yml`, its own sign-in with kept accounts per gateway, Apple push), a watchOS 26+ client of the same gateway: voice Ask around the orb with the work shown live (steps under the orb, pulses), tools and workflow per conversation, images and recordings in answers, approvals (Approve all for the run's own conversation or automation), sessions with search and archive, automations, notifications from your event stream, your avatar on the watch face (the Assistant complication); [watch/apple/docs/README.md](watch/apple/docs/README.md) indexes its pages; [watch/apple/docs/architecture.md](watch/apple/docs/architecture.md) maps each screen to its gateway call; [watch/apple/BUILD.md](watch/apple/BUILD.md) builds and tests it (and the `--dump-notify` notifier readout); [watch/apple/CHANGELOG.md](watch/apple/CHANGELOG.md) is its release history
